blocks.text: SAN FRANCISCO, Agusan del Sur — Residents of Gibusong Island in Loreto town, Dinagat Islands province have renewed their opposition to mining as the Department of Environment and Natural Resources (DENR) begins a fact-finding review into the status of a long-suspended mineral production sharing agreement (MPSA) covering part of the island. The renewed call against mining was raised during a community dialogue on September 17 attended by Dinagat Islands Rep. Kaka Bag-ao, DENR Assistant Secretary for Field Operations for Visayas and Mindanao Felix Alicer, and Mines and Geosciences Bureau (MGB)-Caraga OIC Regional Director Francis Glenn Suante.
